parsed.post: The 0.935620 result was a massive improvement, but I suspect it's data leakage because I set TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD=10. Reverting to 0-9 for my next run to ensure valid metrics. I'll also reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps as suggested by the team.
parsed.description: Reverting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' to avoid eval leakage and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps for better convergence within the 5-minute budget.
